packageRules.description: The kernel, pnpm, slicc-cdp and the wasm command packages move only after the homescoop coordinator certifies them, as in slicc-bios, so Renovate opens their PRs but never merges them; a PR merges once the cert lane has certified that version. The kernel and wasm-* devDependencies are the versions CI tests.
slicc-agent-5 is the newest 5.x agent: the integration tests run it as a follower and guest of another version against this 6.x owner, so it stays on 5.x.
